text: ive done a lot since june 24th but what happened exactly?
resolution: Explained exactly what happened: nothing was truly lost — the SQLite event log (source of truth) survived with all 144 modelCreated / 48 modelDeleted = 96 live models intact; only the rebuildable snapshot CACHE corrupted. Forensics on the event log (read-only, on the backup): the bloat is dominated by 3307 modelPaintBaked events (351MB — a full PNG per stroke) and 14018 partMeshUpdated (119MB), plus 4 giant import events (16.8/33/11.7/4.5MB). On restart the boot loads the entire 575MB log to rebuild the snapshot and OOMs (same class as req_2078, and the documented req_1556 mode), leaving a degraded snapshot with only the last small model. Recovered the full 96 by streaming-replay through a faithful reducer port, validated by exact deep-equality against the Jun-24 _compact_backup.
